shortBio.en: The Doors keyboardist; left-hand bass + organ replaced a bassist onstage.
shortBio.zh: The Doors 键盘手；左手贝斯 + 管风琴代替舞台贝斯手。

body.en:
Born 1939. Vox Continental / Rhodes piano bass under Krieger guitar. Arrangement identity of the classic four.

Post-Morrison projects exist; Doors 1967–71 remains the citation.
body.zh:
1939 年生。Vox Continental / Rhodes 钢琴贝斯托 Krieger 吉他。经典四人编制的编曲身份。

Morrison 后项目存在；引用仍是 Doors 1967–71。
